# <span class="en">Data preparation and quality assessment</span><span class="zh">数据准备与质量评估</span> {#sec-prep}

::: {.en}
Preparation is carried out by `scripts/01_markets.R`, `02_stations.R`, `03_ridership.R` and
`04_frames.R`, reproduced in full in @sec-repro. All of it is in SVY21 (EPSG 3414), the
national projected system, in which distances are in metres. This section explains the
decisions that would have changed the results, each found by checking the data rather
than by reading its documentation. @tbl-mines lists them.
:::

::: {.zh}
数据准备由 `scripts/01_markets.R`、`02_stations.R`、`03_ridership.R` 与 `04_frames.R` 完成，全文收录于
@sec-repro。所有处理都在新加坡的投影坐标系 SVY21（EPSG 3414）下进行，距离单位为米。本节说明那些会改变结果的决策，
它们都是通过检查数据、而不是阅读说明文档发现的。@tbl-mines 列出了这些问题。
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-mines
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>Problems found in the data, what each would have done if left alone, and how it was handled.</span><span class='zh'>数据中发现的问题、不处理会造成的后果，以及处理方式。</span>"
#| echo: false

tribble(
  ~Source, ~Problem, ~`If left alone`, ~Handling,
  "HDB", "Footprints carry a street code (YIR00Z), dwellings a street name (YISHUN RING RD); no key links them", "No dwelling counts on the map", "Crosswalk recovered from shared block numbers (below)",
  "HDB", paste(AM$res_no_footprint, "blocks completed in 2026 have no footprint yet"), paste(n_fmt(AM$res_no_footprint_du), "flats missing"), "Placed at the centre of their street; 2026 blocks kept out of the base market",
  "Population", "June 2024 count predates blocks completed since", "New estates empty, old ones overfull", "Later blocks given the island-wide persons per flat of their type",
  "Population", paste0(pct(100 * AM$share_private), " of residents live outside HDB, and no official layer locates them"), "Bukit Timah and the east coast look empty", "Placed on OSM private housing of the right type",
  "Stations", "Layer holds 15 depots and ancillary buildings among its polygons", "Stations with no passengers", "Kept only codes that are station codes",
  "Stations", "Layer includes four built but closed stations", "Zero-ridership stations in calibration", "Excluded, and kept out of both networks",
  "Stations", "Coordinate list from March 2026 still calls Circle Line Stage 6 future", "Three open stations missing", "Reclassified from the September layer and LTA's page",
  "OD and volumes", "Stage 6 renumbered Marina Bay and Bayfront, so both spellings appear; Stevens is reported as two nodes", "Three stations each split in two", "Merged to physical stations: 187 node codes become 184",
  "OD and volumes", "Monthly totals: August has 20 weekdays, July 23", "August looks 12% lower on weekdays", "Converted to daily averages by a calendar with National Day's holiday",
  "OD and volumes", "Stage 6 opened on 12 July", "Partial month, and a network adjusting", "Reference period is August and September",
  "OD and volumes", paste0("OD totals are ", pct(100 * AR$od_to_node), " of tap-ins, as low as ", pct(100 * AR$od_ratio_range[1]), " at one station"), "Understated ridership", "Observed ridership taken from the station file",
  "Bus stops", paste(AS$bus_dup, "codes entered twice;", nrow(AS$bus_outside), "stops are in Johor Bahru"), "Inflated counts", paste(n_fmt(AS$bus_clean), "stops kept"),
  "Proposed lines", "Seven of the 36 proposed codes are at existing stations", "Same gates counted as new stations", "Treated as existing stations gaining a line",
  "All layers", "Invalid polygons (6 subzones, 4 buildings); station and bus layers have SVY21 with no EPSG code", "Spatial joins fail or drop features", "Repaired; CRS set explicitly"
) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_width(Source ~ px(90), Problem ~ px(270), `If left alone` ~ px(160), Handling ~ px(240)) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))
```

## <span class="en">Local market potential</span><span class="zh">本地市场潜力</span> {#sec-prep-market}

### <span class="en">Linking dwellings to buildings</span><span class="zh">把住宅单位连接到建筑</span>

::: {.en}
The brief recommends HDB Existing Building, but the layer has footprints and no dwellings.
Dwellings are in a separate property table, whose street names do not match the layer's
street codes, and no published table links the two. The block numbers do, because a code
and a name that list the same set of blocks are the same street. Block numbers repeat
across the island, so overlap alone can tie (KG KAYU RD has one block, and many streets have
a block of that number); the code's letters, which abbreviate the street, break the ties.
:::

::: {.zh}
题目推荐使用 HDB Existing Building，但该图层只有建筑轮廓，没有住宅单位数。住宅单位数在另一张房产表中，而表中的街道
名称与图层的街道代码并不对应，也没有公开的对照表。门牌号却能把二者连接起来：列出相同门牌号集合的代码与名称，就是
同一条街。门牌号在全岛会重复，所以只看重合可能出现并列（KG KAYU RD 只有一栋楼，而许多街道都有同号的楼）；代码的
字母是街名的缩写，可以用来打破并列。
:::

```{r}
#| label: crosswalk-code
#| eval: false
#| code-summary: "The street crosswalk (from scripts/01_markets.R)"

pairs <- st_drop_geometry(bld) |>
  select(blk, ST_COD) |>
  inner_join(select(prop, blk, street), by = "blk", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  count(ST_COD, street, name = "n_common") |>
  left_join(n_cod, by = "ST_COD") |>
  left_join(n_str, by = "street") |>
  mutate(jaccard = n_common / (n_cod + n_str - n_common),   # overlap of the two block sets
         letters = mapply(prefix_score, ST_COD, street),    # do the code's letters fit the name?
         score   = jaccard + 0.5 * letters) |>
  arrange(desc(score), desc(n_common))
# ...then a one-to-one assignment, best pair first.
```

```{r}
#| label: crosswalk-result
#| echo: false

cw |>
  arrange(desc(n_common)) |>
  select(ST_COD, street, n_common, n_cod, n_str, jaccard) |>
  head(4) |>
  bind_rows(cw |> arrange(jaccard) |> select(ST_COD, street, n_common, n_cod, n_str, jaccard) |> head(2)) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(jaccard, decimals = 2) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12.5))
```

::: {.en}
The crosswalk assigns `r AM$cw_assigned` of `r AM$cw_codes` street codes, `r AM$cw_perfect` of them with identical
block sets (Jaccard 1), which leaves little room for coincidence; the table shows the largest
matches and the two weakest. The weak ones are streets that gained blocks after the
footprint layer was revised, such as Tengah Garden Avenue. The four unassigned codes hold
`r AM$bld_n - AM$bld_matched` footprints with no property record, and none is a block with
dwellings. Every residential block without a footprint was completed in 2026.
:::

::: {.zh}
对照表为 `r AM$cw_codes` 个街道代码中的 `r AM$cw_assigned` 个找到了匹配，其中 `r AM$cw_perfect` 个的门牌号集合完全相同
（Jaccard 为 1），偶然巧合的余地很小；表中列出了最大的匹配和最弱的两个。较弱的是建筑图层更新后又增加了楼栋的街道，例如
Tengah Garden Avenue。4 个未匹配代码共有 `r AM$bld_n - AM$bld_matched` 个没有房产记录的建筑，其中没有含住宅单位的楼。
所有没有建筑轮廓的住宅楼都是 2026 年竣工的。
:::

```{r}
#| label: pa-check
#| include: false

# Allocated residents by planning area, against the June 2024 table.
pa_off <- readr::read_csv("data/raw/popn/respopagesextod2024.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  group_by(PA = toupper(PA)) |>
  summarise(official = sum(Pop), .groups = "drop")
pa_alloc <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "people_points.rds")) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 3414) |>
  st_join(select(st_make_valid(sz), PA), join = st_within) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(PA = toupper(PA)) |>
  summarise(alloc = sum(res), .groups = "drop")
pa_chk <- inner_join(pa_off, pa_alloc, by = "PA") |> filter(official > 0)
```

### <span class="en">Placing residents</span><span class="zh">定位居民</span>

::: {.en}
Dwellings are not people, and HDB is not everyone. The June 2024 population table gives
residents by subzone and dwelling type, `r n_fmt(AM$pop_total)` in all. HDB residents are spread over
blocks within each subzone and flat type, so a subzone's four-room residents go to its
four-room flats. Blocks completed after the reference date receive the island-wide figure
for their type (from `r num(AM$ppf_city$ppf_city[1])` persons a flat for one- and two-room flats to `r num(AM$ppf_city$ppf_city[4])`
for five-room and executive flats), because the ridership being modelled dates from 2026.

Residents of condominiums and landed houses, `r pct(100 * AM$share_private)` of the total, are placed on
OpenStreetMap buildings: apartments by footprint and houses by count, within each subzone,
after removing `r n_fmt(AM$osm_b_on_hdb)` OSM buildings that are HDB blocks. `r pct(100 * AM$priv_by_tier$res[AM$priv_by_tier$tier == "same type"] / AM$priv_total)`
of them land on buildings of the right type. Allocated residents total `r n_fmt(AM$res_in_hex)`, the
official count plus the estimate for new blocks, by construction. Planning-area totals correlate with the
official ones at `r num(cor(pa_chk$official, pa_chk$alloc), 4)`. Because residents are allocated within subzones, that shows nothing was lost,
not that everyone was placed on the right building. The largest gap is the intended one: Tengah has
`r n_fmt(pa_chk$alloc[pa_chk$PA == "TENGAH"])` residents against `r n_fmt(pa_chk$official[pa_chk$PA == "TENGAH"])` in June 2024, because most of its flats are newer than the count. @fig-market maps the result.
:::

::: {.zh}
住宅单位不等于人，HDB 也不等于所有人。2024 年 6 月的人口表按分区与住宅类型给出居民数，合计 `r n_fmt(AM$pop_total)` 人。
HDB 居民在每个分区内按房型分配到各楼栋，也就是一个分区的四房式居民被分到该分区的四房式单位。人口基准日之后竣工的
楼栋则采用全岛同类房型的平均数（从一、二房式每户 `r num(AM$ppf_city$ppf_city[1])` 人到五房式与公寓式每户
`r num(AM$ppf_city$ppf_city[4])` 人），因为所建模的客流来自 2026 年。

居住在共管公寓与有地住宅的居民占 `r pct(100 * AM$share_private)`，他们被分配到 OpenStreetMap 建筑上：在每个分区内，公寓按
占地面积、独立住宅按栋数，并先剔除 `r n_fmt(AM$osm_b_on_hdb)` 栋实为 HDB 组屋的 OSM 建筑。其中
`r pct(100 * AM$priv_by_tier$res[AM$priv_by_tier$tier == "same type"] / AM$priv_total)` 落在类型正确的建筑上。分配后的居民合计
`r n_fmt(AM$res_in_hex)` 人，这一总数按构造就等于官方人口加上新楼栋的估计数。规划区总量与官方数字的相关系数为 `r num(cor(pa_chk$official, pa_chk$alloc), 4)`。
由于居民是在小区内部分配的，这只说明没有遗漏，并不说明每个人都被安置到了正确的建筑上。最大的差距正是有意为之：登加有 `r n_fmt(pa_chk$alloc[pa_chk$PA == "TENGAH"])` 名居民，而 2024 年 6 月的数字为 `r n_fmt(pa_chk$official[pa_chk$PA == "TENGAH"])`，因为那里的大多数组屋都比这次统计更新。@fig-market 显示了结果。
:::

### <span class="en">Markets that are not homes</span><span class="zh">不是住所的市场</span>

::: {.en}
A station also fills from places where people are not at home. Two activity columns come
from OpenStreetMap: footprint area of `r n_fmt(AS$work_n)` workplace buildings (offices, shops, factories,
schools, hospitals) and a count of `r n_fmt(AS$poi_n)` points of interest, with street furniture such as
benches and vending machines left out. Dormitories get a column of their own (`r AS$dorm_n` buildings):
their occupants are mostly foreign workers and students, who are outside the resident count
but very much on the trains. OSM has no building heights, so footprint understates the
tall offices of the CBD, a bias discussed in @sec-calib.
:::

::: {.zh}
车站的客流也来自人们不在家的地方。OpenStreetMap 提供了两个活动字段：`r n_fmt(AS$work_n)` 栋工作场所建筑（办公楼、商店、工厂、
学校、医院）的占地面积，以及 `r n_fmt(AS$poi_n)` 个兴趣点的数量，其中剔除了长椅、自动售货机之类的街道设施。宿舍单独设一个
字段（`r AS$dorm_n` 栋）：其住户多为外籍劳工与学生，不在居民统计之内，却是地铁的常客。OSM 没有建筑高度，所以占地面积低估了
CBD 高层办公楼，@sec-calib 将讨论这一偏差。
:::

```{r}
#| label: fig-market
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>Local market potential by 500 m hexagon: residents at home (left) and workplace footprint (right).</span><span class='zh'>500 米六边形的本地市场潜力：居民（左）与工作场所占地面积（右）。</span>"
#| fig-height: 3.9
#| code-fold: true

hm <- function(col, title, trans = "sqrt", lab = waiver(), br = waiver()) {
  map_base(
    geom_sf(data = filter(hex, .data[[col]] > 0), aes(fill = .data[[col]]), colour = NA),
    net_layer("#44403c", .18)
  ) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = RAMP_SEQ, trans = trans, labels = lab, breaks = br, name = NULL) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"), legend.key.height = unit(.25, "cm"))
}
hm("residents", "Residents", lab = comma) + hm("work_m2", "Workplace footprint (m²)", lab = comma, br = c(20000, 75000, 150000))
```

::: {.interp .en}
**Homes and activity sit in different places, which a single market cannot represent.**
Residents fill a ring of new towns, from Woodlands round through Punggol to Tampines and across
to Jurong West. Workplace footprint concentrates in Jurong, Tuas and the northern industrial
estates, far from those towns. The CBD barely registers on the right-hand map, despite being
the country's largest employment centre, which is the height bias at work. Both facts shape the
model. A station's ridership cannot be explained by one market, and this measure of activity
is better at saying where activity is than how much of it there is.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**住所与活动分布在不同地方，单一市场无法表示。** 居民集中在一圈新市镇：从兀兰经榜鹅到淡滨尼，再到裕廊西。工作场所占地
则集中在裕廊、大士与北部工业区，远离这些市镇。CBD 虽是全国最大的就业中心，在右图中却几乎看不出来，这正是高度偏差的
表现。这两点都影响建模：车站的客流无法用单一市场解释，而这个活动指标更善于说明活动在哪里，而不是有多少。
:::

## <span class="en">Observed ridership</span><span class="zh">观测客流</span> {#sec-prep-rid}

::: {.en}
A node code can name an interchange ("NS24/NE6/CC1"), and three stations appear under two.
Circle Line Stage 6 opened on 12 July 2026 [@lta_ccl6] and renumbered Marina Bay and Bayfront
(CE2 to CC33, CE1 to CC34), so both spellings are in the July file; Stevens is reported as
separate nodes for its two lines. After merging, `r AR$raw_codes` node codes give `r AR$stations` stations,
each of which appears in the data. Thomson-East Coast Line Stage 5 and Downtown Line Stage 3e
do not appear, so they had not opened by September, and they are left out of both networks
[@lta_tel].

Monthly totals mislead because the calendar differs: on the face of it August's weekdays carry
12% fewer tap-ins than July's, but August has 20 weekdays and July 23. Per day, the two months
are within 1.4% of each other (@tbl-calendar). The months also agree closely station by
station: August and September weekday ridership correlate at `r num(AR$stab_aug_sep_cor, 3)` on the log
scale, and the median station moves by `r pct(100 * AR$stab_aug_sep_mape)`.
:::

::: {.zh}
节点代码可以表示一个换乘站（"NS24/NE6/CC1"），而有三个车站以两个节点出现。环线第六期于 2026 年 7 月 12 日开通
[@lta_ccl6]，并为滨海湾与海湾舫重新编号（CE2 改为 CC33，CE1 改为 CC34），所以 7 月的文件中两种写法都有；Stevens 则按
两条线路分别报告为两个节点。合并之后，`r AR$raw_codes` 个节点代码对应 `r AR$stations` 个车站，每个车站都出现在数据中。
汤东线第五期与滨海市区线 3e 期没有出现，说明到 9 月尚未开通，因此两个网络都不包含它们 [@lta_tel]。

月度总量具有误导性，因为日历不同：表面上 8 月工作日的进站量比 7 月少 12%，但 8 月只有 20 个工作日，7 月有 23 个。
按日计算，两个月相差不超过 1.4%（@tbl-calendar）。各月在单站层面也高度一致：8、9 月工作日客流在对数尺度上的相关系数为
`r num(AR$stab_aug_sep_cor, 3)`，单站变动的中位数为 `r pct(100 * AR$stab_aug_sep_mape)`。
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-calendar
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>Tap-ins by month and day type. The per-day column removes the calendar. Monday 10 August 2026 is a public holiday, because National Day falls on a Sunday.</span><span class='zh'>按月份与日类型统计的进站量。每日列消除了日历的影响。2026 年 8 月 10 日（周一）为公共假日，因为国庆日适逢周日。</span>"
#| echo: false

AR$month_check |>
  transmute(Month = YEAR_MONTH, `Day type` = DAY_TYPE, `Tap-ins` = tap_in, Days = days, `Per day` = per_day) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(c(`Tap-ins`, `Per day`), decimals = 0) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12.5))
```

::: {.en}
**The reference period** is August and September. July is left out, because Stage 6 has a
partial month in it and the rest of the network was still adjusting to a closed circle. The
OD file falls short of the station file because it records only completed journeys, and a
tap-in with no matching tap-out cannot be in it, so the station file is the source of
observed ridership and the OD file is used only for destination shares.
:::

::: {.zh}
**基准期**取 8、9 月。7 月被排除，因为其中第六期只有部分月份，而全网也还在适应环线闭合。OD 文件的总量低于车站文件，因为它只
记录完整的行程，没有对应出站的进站不会出现在其中，所以观测客流取自车站文件，OD 文件只用于目的地份额。
:::

## <span class="en">Attraction variables</span><span class="zh">吸引力变量</span> {#sec-prep-attr}

::: {.en}
Attraction variables are measured the same way for existing and proposed stations, because a
proposed station has nothing else to be predicted from. They are the number of bus stops, retail
and service points of interest, and food points of interest within 400 m; whether a station has
only LRT; how many lines beyond the first it has; and rail time to Raffles Place. The last comes from a
graph of the network, with distance over an assumed running speed (35 km/h for MRT, 30 for the
Jurong Region Line, 20 for LRT, including stops) and a 5-minute penalty for each change. It
has to be recalculated for the proposed network, because the new lines shorten it for some
existing stations.
:::

::: {.zh}
吸引力变量在既有车站与拟建车站上按同样方式测量，因为拟建车站没有其他依据可供预测。它们包括 400 米内的公交站数量、零售与
服务类兴趣点数量、餐饮类兴趣点数量；车站是否只有轻轨；除第一条线路外还有几条线路；以及到 Raffles Place 的轨道时间。最后一项来自
铁路网图：距离除以假定的运行速度（地铁 35 公里/小时、裕廊区域线 30、轻轨 20，均已包含停站），每次换乘加 5 分钟。拟建网络下需要
重新计算，因为新线缩短了部分既有车站的这一时间。
:::

## <span class="en">The data frames the brief asks for</span><span class="zh">题目要求的数据框</span> {#sec-prep-frames}

::: {.en}
Four tables come out of preparation. The two interaction frames share their column names, as
MCI's functions require: `si_existing` has `r n_fmt(AF$n_pairs_existing)` origin-destination pairs and
`si_proposed` has `r n_fmt(AF$n_pairs_proposed)`. `origins` holds the local market potential and
`dest_existing` the observed ridership and attraction variables. The attractiveness columns
are filled in after calibration.
:::

::: {.zh}
数据准备产生四张表。两个交互数据框的列名相同，这是 MCI 函数的要求：`si_existing` 有 `r n_fmt(AF$n_pairs_existing)` 对起讫点，
`si_proposed` 有 `r n_fmt(AF$n_pairs_proposed)` 对。`origins` 保存本地市场潜力，`dest_existing` 保存观测客流与吸引力变量。
吸引力列在校准后填入。
:::

```{r}
#| label: frames-preview

si_e |> filter(in_range) |> slice_sample(n = 3)
si_p |> filter(destination %in% NT$destination, in_range) |> slice_sample(n = 3)
origins |> select(origin, residents, res_private, hdb_du, dorm_m2, work_m2, poi) |> slice_max(residents, n = 3)
dE |> select(destination, station_name, daily_in, phi, T_H, T_W, bus_400, retail_400, food_400, lrt, ic, min_cbd) |>
  slice_max(daily_in, n = 3)
```
